description: XLSX data cover 23 months in eight district-metered areas, including meter consumption, private-tank volumes and pressures. Four areas underwent pressure reduction and four did not. This resource is provided by Daniela Bonazzi Sodek. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists XLSX formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The observational comparison does not itself identify a causal effect of pressure changes. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
